official_references.matched_structure: Bespoke Link material selection and goal checks beyond AddLinkProcedure defaults.
official_references.official_effect_text:
4+ Effect Monsters
[b]You can[/b] [b]also[/b] use 1 monster your opponent controls as material to Link Summon this card. If this card is Link Summoned: [b]You can[/b] [b]negate[/b] the effects of all face-up monsters your opponent currently controls. This Link Summoned card is [b]unaffected[/b] by your opponent's activated effects, unless they [b]target[/b] this card. [b]Once[/b] [b]per turn[/b], [b]when[/b] your opponent activates a card or effect that Special Summons a monster(s) from the GY ([b]Quick Effect[/b]): [b]You can[/b] [b]negate[/b] the activation.

effects.printed_clause: If Link Summoned: target a Vir Pedicae Mortis in GY; Special Summon it. HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Link-Summon delayed trigger targets a Necrovalley-valid archetype monster and revives it; HOPT.

official_references.matched_structure: Zombie Link Monster trigger Special Summons a monster from a GY with target and zone checks.
official_references.official_effect_text:
2 Zombie monsters
If you would Tribute a monster(s) for a Tribute Summon, [b]you can[/b] Tribute a Zombie monster(s) your opponent controls, even though you do not control them. [b]You can[/b] only use each of the following effects of "Vampire Sucker" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b]. [b]You can[/b] [b]target[/b] 1 monster in your opponent's GY; Special Summon it to your opponent's field in Defense Position, but it becomes a Zombie monster. If a Zombie monster(s) is Special Summoned from either GY: Draw 1 card.

effects.printed_clause: If Bear Trap was activated this turn: Quick Effect target up to 2 opponent cards; destroy them. HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Quick Effect checks a turn flag registered whenever Bear Trap activation enters a chain, targets 1-2 destructible opponent cards and destroys related targets; HOPT.

official_references.official_effect_text: [b]Target[/b] 1 "Time Thief" Xyz Monster you control; attach 1 "Time Thief" card from your hand or Deck to it as material. [b]You can[/b] [b]banish[/b] this card from your GY, [b]then[/b] [b]target[/b] 1 "Time Thief" Xyz Monster you control; attach 1 card from your opponent's GY to it as material. [b]You can[/b] only use 1 "Time Thief Flyback" effect [b]per turn[/b], [b]and[/b] only [b]once[/b] that turn.
